narrative.overview: The interface is a shrine chamber entered after dusk. Light is rationed and deliberate: the ground stays near-black, velvet panels absorb it, and gilt returns it only where meaning lives — a rule, a plaque, a mirror that has earned its shine. Every generated sher is presented inside a lit, arched alcove like an offering on a shrine ledge, and the product's honesty rides the same material: demo verses carry pressed stamps, research entries carry verification seals and coverage notes. Density is generous at rest, intimate in focus; controls recede into the chamber's behavior, with state expressed as light level (frosted → backlit → gilt-flooded), never as announced chips. Motion is candlelight logic: slow ignitions, blur-up reveals, a slow petal drift; nothing snaps, nothing spins.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with warm candle pools; burgundy bleeds from the floor.
Gilt border rules of true brass weight frame every structural boundary.
Mirror-mosaic tessellation appears as structure (alcove interiors), never wallpaper.
One lit alcove holds the finished poem; its rim brightens while it works.
Roman Urdu typography rides EB Garamond; Urdu script always Nastaliq with deep leading.

rules.name: The Brass-Never-Blue Rule
rules.body: Every interactive affordance the browser would paint blue or white — focus rings, selection, caret, scrollbars, underline accents — is dressed in gilt. Blue never appears.

rules.name: The One Lit Alcove Rule
rules.body: Only one poem at a time holds the light; the alcove's rim and mirror tiles brighten while it works and settle when it rests.

rules.name: The Ledger Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything that states provenance, status, or research honesty is set in Courier Prime small caps — it reads as an entry in a record book, not UI chrome.

rules.name: The Candle Doesn't Jump Rule
rules.body: State changes cross-fade over 300–420ms on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); nothing appears instantly and nothing slides.

dos: Do express every interactive state as light level (frost → backlit → gilt flood) with 300–420ms ease.
Do set all Urdu-script text in Nastaliq at lh 2.15, RTL, zero letter-spacing, with unicode-bidi: isolate.
Do label provenance in Courier Prime: demo verses, research statuses, coverage notes. Honesty is part of the finish.
Do keep body text against a scrim or well when tiles glow behind it (≥4.5:1).
donts: Don't paint any interactive default blue/white; focus, selection, carets and scrollbars are gilt.
Don't render fire/velvet/mirror as flat site-wide wallpaper; the mosaic and velvet exist inside structural recesses only.
Don't stack gradients or halo shadows without offset; depth is recess + relief, never decoration.
Don't invent metaphors of other worlds (SaaS violet, neon, pastel) — the chamber has one voice.
